name: Group Theory / Permutation Orbit Obfuscation
description: Reframes the problem from vector space hyperplanes to group theory. The "mechanisms" become transpositions generating the symmetric group $S_n$. The requirement to "couple" states becomes ensuring critical elements are in the same "orbit" under the action of the generated subgroup. This hides the graph and tree structure behind group-theoretic language, exploiting the theorem that orbits of a transposition-generated subgroup correspond exactly to connected components of the transposition graph, forcing models to bridge this conceptual gap rather than blindly applying tree traversals.
